section_1.title: Prerequisites: Vectors as Areas
section_1.content: Briefly recap that for a 2x2 matrix, the determinant represents the signed area of the parallelogram formed by the column vectors. Visualize the vectors [a, c] and [b, d] on a 2D plane.
section_1.example: Visualize a parallelogram spanning from the origin to (2, 1) and (1, 2). The area (determinant) is 3.

section_2.title: The Linear System as a Geometric Transformation
section_2.content: Explain the system Ax = b as a vector combination: x * v1 + y * v2 = b. Geometrically, we are looking for the 'weights' x and y that stretch and add the base vectors to reach the destination vector b.
section_2.example: A robotic arm with two joints at fixed angles; find the extensions x and y to reach target point b.

section_3.title: Geometric Derivation of Cramer's Rule
section_3.content: Show that by replacing a column of the original matrix with b, we create a new parallelogram. Explain that the ratio of the area of this new parallelogram to the original is exactly the value of the variable (x or y).
section_3.example: If the original area is 3, and replacing the first column creates a new area of 6, then x = 6/3 = 2.

section_4.title: Visual Synthesis & Intuition
section_4.content: Provide a side-by-side animation: The transformation of the unit square into the target parallelogram vs. the shrinking/stretching required to map b onto the axes.
section_4.example: A 'Pixel Character' scale transformation: Show the total area changing, and how the sub-area relative to the total dictates the coordinate value.

section_5.title: Summary and Constraint
section_5.content: Conclude by noting that this geometric interpretation works only when the determinant is non-zero (i.e., the parallelogram has non-zero area). If the area is zero, the vectors are collinear, and no unique solution exists.
section_5.example: A 'Flat Tire' scenario: If the parallelogram collapses into a line, you cannot define a unique coordinate for the point b.

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text("- " + line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 1.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 0.8
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Summary and Constraint", ["Determinant must be non-zero.", "Zero area implies collinear vectors.", "Unique solutions require area existence."])
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Determinant must be non-zero.
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        
        det_eq = MathTex(r"\det(A) \neq 0").set_color(BLUE)
        self.place_at_grid(det_eq, 'B2', scale_factor=1.5)
        self.play(Write(det_eq))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Zero area implies collinear vectors.
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE), self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(RED))
        
        vec_v = Arrow(ORIGIN, RIGHT + UP, color=GREEN)
        vec_w = Arrow(ORIGIN, 2 * RIGHT + 2 * UP, color=RED)

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Summary and Constraint", ["Determinant must be non-zero.", "Zero area implies collinear vectors.", "Unique solutions require area existence."])
        
        # Load assets
        icon_asset = "/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg"
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Determinant must be non-zero.
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#00FF00"))
        
        det_eq = MathTex(r"\det(A) \neq 0").set_color(BLUE)
        self.place_at_grid(det_eq, 'B4', scale_factor=0.7)
        icon1 = SVGMobject(icon_asset).scale(0.5).next_to(det_eq, RIGHT)
        self.play(Write(det_eq), FadeIn(icon1))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Zero area implies collinear vectors.
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE), self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(RED))
        
        vec_v = Arrow(ORIGIN, RIGHT + UP, color=GREEN)
        vec_w = Arrow(ORIGIN, 2 * RIGHT + 2 * UP, color=RED)
        collinear_group = VGroup(vec_v, vec_w)
        self.place_in_area(collinear_group, 'D4', 'D6', scale_factor=0.8)
        self.play(Create(collinear_group))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Unique solutions require area existence.
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE), self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE))
        
        area_rect = Polygon(ORIGIN, RIGHT*2, RIGHT*2+UP, UP, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.3)
        self.place_at_grid(area_rect, 'F2', scale_factor=0.6)
        icon2 = SVGMobject(icon_asset).scale(0.5).next_to(area_rect, RIGHT)
        self.play(FadeIn(area_rect), FadeIn(icon2))
        
        self.wait(2)
